title: Bias in AI
listing_description: An original course chapter on the many distinct mechanisms hidden by the single word ‘bias,’ from statistical variation to social harm.
reader_hook: Begin by separating the problems called bias before deciding what a model, a dataset, or an institution can responsibly claim to have fixed.
